summary: frontend-orb preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook running `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-identifier renaming, per-function string dictionaries) and, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle using rotating string-array indirection and prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs` so it only runs under Bun, not Node. The package advertises itself as a CircleCI orb (YAML source under src/) and has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime or a large obfuscated JavaScript payload. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern is specifically designed so Node-based supply-chain scanners tracing `require()` do not observe the executed code. Installing this package results in execution of opaque attacker-controlled code on the installer's host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
